name: keep-record
description: Use when users are reporting or logging personal health data such as meals, drinks, weight, body fat, body measurements, workouts, sleep, or menstrual cycle, even if they do not explicitly mention Keep or ask to save it. Prefer this skill for logging-style utterances like 早餐吃了鸡蛋面, 今天体重65kg, 跑了5km, 昨晚睡了7小时, 帮我记一下, or Keep 打卡, rather than advice, analysis, or general chat.
author: Keep
